report_name: Latin American Ransomware Uses BitLocker, Prints Physical Ransom Notes

threat_actors.name: XEntry Team
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group identified in ransomware attacks in Colombia and Mexico, using BitLocker for encryption and printers for ransom notes.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: Attackers gained initial access by exploiting misconfigured internet-facing services such as RDP or VPNs.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used PowerShell to enable and configure BitLocker on target systems.

attack_patterns.name: System Binary Proxy Execution
attack_patterns.description: The encryption process was performed by a trusted system component, manage-bde.exe, to evade detection.

attack_patterns.name: Masquerading
attack_patterns.description: The use of the legitimate BitLocker encryption process masqueraded the malicious activity as legitimate administrative action.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The attackers used Microsoft's BitLocker feature to encrypt system drives and hold data for ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Defacement
attack_patterns.description: Corporate printers were hijacked to print physical ransom notes, a form of physical defacement designed to create panic and disruption.

tools.name: BitLocker
tools.description: Legitimate Microsoft Windows drive encryption feature abused by attackers to encrypt victim systems as a 'living-off-the-land' technique.

tools.name: manage-bde.exe
tools.description: The command-line tool for managing BitLocker, used by attackers to script the encryption of victim drives.

indicators.name: Malicious BitLocker Enablement via manage-bde.exe
indicators.pattern:
title: Malicious BitLocker Enablement via manage-bde.exe
id: 2b8a1c3d-f4e5-4b9a-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of manage-bde.exe to enable BitLocker encryption with a recovery password, a technique used in living-off-the-land ransomware attacks.
references:
  - https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2026/07/293589-ransomware-attacks-targeting-colombia-and-mexico-based-businesses-examined-in-new-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-27
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\manage-bde.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' -on '
      - ' -RecoveryPassword'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command-line execution of manage-bde.exe to turn on BitLocker with a new recovery password, a key step in the observed LotL ransomware attacks.

indicators.name: Malicious BitLocker Key Protector Addition via PowerShell
indicators.pattern:
title: Malicious BitLocker Key Protector Addition via PowerShell
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-2c1b-0a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of the Add-BitLockerKeyProtector PowerShell cmdlet to add a password protector, a technique used in living-off-the-land ransomware attacks.
references:
  - https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2026/07/293589-ransomware-attacks-targeting-colombia-and-mexico-based-businesses-examined-in-new-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-27
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1059.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'Add-BitLockerKeyProtector'
      - '-PasswordProtector'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the PowerShell cmdlet 'Add-BitLockerKeyProtector' to add a password to a volume, a method used by attackers to lock legitimate owners out of their data.
